description: Approves a single AI problem proposal (when proposalId is provided) or all pending proposals in an active feedback problem analysis set (when proposalId is omitted), creating or reusing canonical Problems and linking evidence. Requires problems:write.

analysisSetId.description: Active problem analysis set UUID from feedback_problem_review_get.

feedbackId.description: Optional feedback UUID for audit correlation.

proposalId.description: Specific proposal ID to approve. Omit to approve all pending proposals in the analysis set.

proposalOverrides.description: Optional overrides to link a proposal to an existing problem (kind="reuse" or "contradicts", problemId) or force creation (kind="create").

kind.description: Override action: create a new problem, reuse an existing problem, or link as contradicting evidence.

problemId.description: Target canonical problem UUID when kind is "reuse" or "contradicts".

proposalId.description: Proposal ID within the analysis set to override.

name: problem_proposal_approve
title: Approve Problem Proposal
